audit_mode: Independent standard-library readback only. No project script imported/executed; no solver, compiler, generation, training, diagnostic, or member postprocessor executed; existing evidence unchanged.

identity.cache_key_formula: SHA256 compact sort-key JSON of method_id, case_id, input_sha256, binary_sha256, framework_sha256, params_sha256

protocol.Hit_Count_plus_Miss_Count: matches independently read input header and actual PROBE count in all 90 records

primary_formula: 0 when VAL<=0 or BASE<=0, else clamp(10*(1-VAL/BASE),0,10); uncapped sum of ten cases for each member; equal mean of three member sums

p50_caveat.source_markdown: Generic p50/P50 labels contain nearest-rank values; publication should name the definition.
p50_caveat.ordinary_median: For n=30: mean of sorted positions 15 and 16 (1-based).

limits: Purposive 30-case partial sample, one repeat; cannot establish full-dataset or official competition ranking.
edges_all_empty cost is pure formal D (IO=0, Miss=0): 1.44 vs 0.68 microseconds. Single-run sub-microsecond difference cannot establish stable regression or its cause.
R65 retains 7/30 cost>Naive and 20/30 D>Naive; clipped per-case scores hide cost tails.
Formal D is the official internal chrono policy duration, distinct from GNU process CPU, elapsed, parent wall, and diagnostic build timing.
No new measurements or original report edits were made.
raw_evidence_note: Public stdout/stderr relative paths with original result SHA; stdout is byte-identical; stderr command/path line is removed and both hashes retained.

publication_derivation.transform: Replace private source/raw path references with labels, source SHA256, and relative public raw paths; audited numerical values unchanged.
